audience: Head of a sectoral ICT unit · project lead who accepts the documents

videos.title: From one file to a running application
videos.message: The kit turns the model into the platform's forms, lists, menus and workflow, and installs them.

videos.title: Nothing generated is edited by hand
videos.message: A correction goes into the description and the application is generated again; a program shows any hand edit.

videos.title: The platform's traps, caught before deployment
videos.message: What is known to fail on the platform is checked before anything is installed.

videos.title: Identity and registries: use the block, do not rebuild it
videos.message: The service takes a person's identity and an institution's record from the body that keeps them.

videos.title: The service's contract with the registration block, and its data interface
videos.message: The contract another system reads is produced from the description, not written beside it.

videos.title: Payments and information mediation as named crossings
videos.message: A payment or a call across the data exchange is a crossing the architecture names, not a block the service rebuilds.

videos.title: Proof on the running system: a task a person finishes
videos.message: The last check is a person finishing a real task on the running service, and the record that they did.
